request.description:
Basic update - केवल JSON data के साथ files के बिना

**Usage:** जब सिर्फ student की details update करनी हो, files नहीं।

**Example Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "studentId": 1,
  "name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "phoneNo": "9876543210",
  "gender": "Male",
  "caste": "General"
}
```

Photo के साथ update - student की profile photo upload करो

**Upload करते समय:**
1. Body → form-data select करो
2. "photo" row में file select करो
3. अपनी image file choose करो (JPG/PNG)
4. Send करो

**Response में file URL मिलेगा:**
```json
{
  "studentPhoto": "http://localhost:8080/api/admin/students/files/STU_1234567890_photo.jpg"
}
```

सभी documents के साथ complete update

**सभी files upload करो:**
- Student photo
- Marksheet
- Transfer Certificate (TC)
- Aadhar Card
- Samagra Card
- Bank Passbook
- APAAR Card

**Response में सभी file URLs मिलेंगे:**
```json
{
  "studentPhoto": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "lastClassMarksheet": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "tcImage": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "aadharCardImage": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "samagraIdImage": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "bankPassbookImage": "http://localhost:8080/...",
  "apaarCardImage": "http://localhost:8080/..."
}
```

Real-world example: Phone number और father details update करना

**Updated Fields:**
- phoneNo: 9988776655
- fatherName: Ramesh Kumar
- fatherContactNumber: 9876543210
- address: 456 Oak Avenue, Delhi

✅ YE FIELDS UPDATE KAR SAKTE HO:

**Personal Details:**
- phoneNo (string) - Mobile number (9 digits)
- gender (string) - Male/Female/Other
- address (string) - Residential address
- caste (string) - Caste information

**Family Details:**
- fatherName (string) - Father's full name
- motherName (string) - Mother's full name
- fatherContactNumber (string) - Father's phone (10 digits)

**ID Numbers:**
- aadharCardNo (string) - 12-digit Aadhar number
- samagraId (string) - Samagra ID
- rollNumber (string) - Roll number in class

**Files/Documents:**
- photo (file) - JPG/PNG image
- marksheet (file) - Last class marksheet
- tc (file) - Transfer Certificate
- aadharImg (file) - Aadhar card scanned copy
- samagraImg (file) - Samagra ID card copy
- passbookImg (file) - Bank passbook copy
- apaarImg (file) - APAAR card copy

**JSON Format Example:**
```json
{
  "phoneNo": "9876543210",
  "gender": "Male",
  "address": "123 Main Street, Delhi",
  "caste": "General",
  "fatherName": "John Doe",
  "motherName": "Jane Doe",
  "fatherContactNumber": "9988776655",
  "aadharCardNo": "123456789012",
  "samagraId": "SAM123456",
  "rollNumber": "A001"
}
```

❌ YE FIELDS UPDATE NAHI KAR SAKTE (Onboarding time set hote hain):

**Core Details (Fixed):**
- name - Student का full name (onboarding में set)
- email - Email address (onboarding में set)
- password - Password (onboarding में set)
- dateOfBirth - Date of birth (onboarding में set)

**School/Class (Promotion से change करते hain):**
- schoolId - School (promotion API से change करो)
- classId - Class (promotion API से change करो)
- sectionId - Section (promotion API से change करो)
- academicYear - Academic year (special API से)

**Auto Generated:**
- enrollmentId - Auto-generated (edit nahi kar sakte)
- apaarId - Auto-generated (edit nahi kar sakte)
- studentId - Auto-generated ID (primary key)

**agar ye change karne hain toh:**
1. Name/DOB/Email change: Contact Admin (Onboarding को redo karna padega)
2. Class/Section change: Promotion API use करो
3. School change: New enrollment create करो

**phoneNo** (String, Optional)
- Format: 10 digits
- Example: "9876543210"
- Purpose: Student's contact number

**gender** (String, Optional)
- Values: "Male", "Female", "Other"
- Example: "Male"
- Purpose: Student's gender

**address** (String, Optional)
- Format: Any string
- Example: "123 Main Street, Delhi"
- Purpose: Residential address

**caste** (String, Optional)
- Values: "General", "OBC", "SC", "ST", etc.
- Example: "General"
- Purpose: Caste category

**fatherName** (String, Optional)
- Format: Any string
- Example: "Ramesh Kumar"
- Purpose: Father's full name

**motherName** (String, Optional)
- Format: Any string
- Example: "Priya Sharma"
- Purpose: Mother's full name

**fatherContactNumber** (String, Optional)
- Format: 10 digits
- Example: "9988776655"
- Purpose: Father's phone number

**aadharCardNo** (String, Optional)
- Format: 12 digits
- Example: "123456789012"
- Purpose: Aadhar card number

**samagraId** (String, Optional)
- Format: Alphanumeric
- Example: "SAM123456789"
- Purpose: Samagra ID from MP Government

**rollNumber** (String, Optional)
- Format: Any string
- Example: "A001" or "001"
- Purpose: Student's roll number in class

# 🟢 COMPULSORY (हमेशा देना पड़ता है)

## studentData Parameter
**Format:** JSON string
**Required:** हाँ (हमेशा)
**Example:**
```json
{
  "phoneNo": "9876543210",
  "gender": "Male"
}
```

**क्यों compulsory है?**
- API को पता चलना चाहिए कि update करना क्या है
- भले ही empty object {} भेजो, parameter तो देना ही पड़ता है
- बिना इसके API error देगा

---

# 🟡 OPTIONAL (चाहो तो दो, न चाहो तो न दो)

## File Parameters
- photo
- marksheet
- tc (Transfer Certificate)
- aadharImg
- samagraImg
- passbookImg
- apaarImg

**क्यों optional हैं?**
- हर बार सभी files upload करने की ज़रूरत नहीं
- सिर्फ वो files दो जो update करने हैं
- बाकी files unchanged रहेंगी

**उदाहरण:**
- अगर सिर्फ photo update करना है → photo दो, बाकी न दो
- अगर सभी documents update करने हैं → सभी दो
- अगर कोई file update नहीं करना → कोई भी file न दो

---

# 📝 JSON FIELDS - OPTIONAL या REQUIRED?

**studentData JSON में सभी fields OPTIONAL हैं:**

✅ आप ये कर सकते हो:
```json
{ "phoneNo": "9876543210" }  ← सिर्फ phone
{ "gender": "Male" }  ← सिर्फ gender
{ "phoneNo": "9876543210", "gender": "Male" }  ← दोनों
{ }  ← खाली भी ठीक है (कुछ update नहीं)
```

❌ ये नहीं कर सकते:
```json
{ "name": "John" }  ← name read-only है
{ "schoolId": 1 }  ← schoolId read-only है
```

---

# 🎯 PRACTICAL EXAMPLES

**Example 1: सिर्फ phone update करना**
```
studentData: {"phoneNo": "9876543210"}
Files: कोई नहीं
```

**Example 2: Photo के साथ multiple fields update करना**
```
studentData: {"phoneNo": "9876543210", "gender": "Male", "address": "..."}
Files: photo (1 file)
```

**Example 3: सभी documents के साथ complete update**
```
studentData: {"phoneNo": "9876543210", "fatherName": "...", ...}
Files: photo, marksheet, tc, aadharImg, samagraImg, passbookImg, apaarImg (7 files)
```

---

# ⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES

1. **studentData हमेशा देना पड़ता है** - भले ही empty {} भी हो
2. **Files optional हैं** - सिर्फ वो दो जो update करने हैं
3. **File overwrite होगी** - अगर पुरानी file है तो replace हो जाएगी
4. **Student ID ज़रूरी है** - URL में /1 में 1 वो student का ID है
5. **Status codes समझो:**
   - 200 = Success ✅
   - 400 = Bad request (wrong JSON)
   - 404 = Student not found
   - 500 = Server error

# ❌ ERROR 1: 400 Bad Request

**Error Message:** "Invalid student data JSON - Unrecognized field"

**Cause:**
- JSON format गलत है
- Non-editable field add किया है (जैसे name, email)

**Solution:**
```json
// ❌ WRONG
{"name": "John", "phoneNo": "9876543210"}

// ✅ CORRECT
{"phoneNo": "9876543210"}
```

---

# ❌ ERROR 2: 404 Not Found

**Error Message:** "Student not found with ID: 99999"

**Cause:**
- गलत Student ID दिया है
- वो student database में नहीं है

**Solution:**
- सही Student ID check करो
- GET /api/admin/students endpoint से list देख

---

# ❌ ERROR 3: 500 Internal Server Error

**Error Message:** "File processing failed - ..."

**Cause:**
- File upload में problem
- Disk space issue
- File format invalid

**Solution:**
- File size check करो (बहुत बड़ी न हो)
- File format check करो (JPG/PNG images, PDF documents)
- Server logs check करो

---

# ❌ ERROR 4: Missing studentData

**Error Message:** "Required parameter 'studentData' not found"

**Cause:**
- studentData parameter भूल गया

**Solution:**
```
// यह देना ही पड़ता है
studentData: {}
// या
studentData: {"phoneNo": "9876543210"}
```

---

# ❌ ERROR 5: Invalid JSON Format

**Error Message:** "Invalid JSON data for student update"

**Cause:**
- JSON syntax गलत है
- Quotes मिस्मैच

**Solution:**
```json
// ❌ WRONG (single quotes)
{'phoneNo': '9876543210'}

// ✅ CORRECT (double quotes)
{"phoneNo": "9876543210"}
```

---

# ✅ SUCCESS RESPONSE: 200 OK

```json
{
  "studentId": 1,
  "name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "phoneNo": "9876543210",
  "gender": "Male",
  "address": "123 Main Street",
  "caste": "General",
  "fatherName": "Ramesh Kumar",
  "motherName": "Priya Sharma",
  "studentPhoto": "http://localhost:8080/api/admin/students/files/STU_1234567890_photo.jpg",
  "lastClassMarksheet": "http://localhost:8080/api/admin/students/files/MRK_1234567890_marksheet.pdf",
  "tcImage": null,
  "aadharCardImage": null,
  "samagraIdImage": null,
  "bankPassbookImage": null,
  "apaarCardImage": null
}
```

**क्या देखो:**
- सभी updated fields में नई values हैं
- File URLs मिलेंगे (अगर file upload किया तो)
- null वाली files mean वो upload नहीं हुई
